what_differs: WAGR-191 built the referrer Default Payout Type with the Aug 18 wording (Cash, Redeposit). On Sep 25 WagerTech decided to keep the term 'bet credit', and the signup payout type must default from the referrer default. The Sign-Up Referral Type and payout matrix use Cash/Bet Credit (WAGR-289), so the default cannot map cleanly; WAGR-465 still lists the naming as open.
suggested_action: Rename the WAGR-191 picklist value Redeposit to Bet Credit (or add an explicit mapping) as part of WAGR-428, and close the naming question on WAGR-465.
